name: Tokenyard
summary: An admin console for an AI API business: live traffic, keys, usage, model prices and billing
about: An admin dashboard for a company that sells AI through an API. A live traffic map sends a glowing particle from customer to model for every request, while customers, API keys, usage, model pricing, invoices, rate limits and request logs sit one click away. A playground streams a reply token by token with a cost estimate. Good for an AI startup, a developer tool or any service billed by usage.
how: Watch the live traffic map on the overview: each request travels from a customer to a model, and the KPIs tick up.
Create an API key with scopes; the full secret is shown once with a copy button, and keys can be rolled or revoked.
Open a customer to see spend and keys, add credit, change plan and spend cap, or suspend them.
Edit a model's price per million tokens and the price simulator shows next month's revenue right away.
Retry failed invoice charges in Billing and edit RPM and TPM limits per tier, plus overrides per customer.
Filter the live request log by status code, pause it, and open any request to see its redacted JSON.
Try a prompt in the playground and watch the answer stream in with token count, speed and cost.
